title: Accounts Assistant
description: **Who are GridBeyond?** GridBeyond are a green tech energy scale-up company, with big plans to disrupt the energy sector on a relentless course to achieve our vision of delivering a global zero carbon future. With well-established roots in the demand side response space, we have expanded our commercial strategical thinking and product portfolio to enable us to break new global market barriers. **How do GridBeyond do this?** We do this by living our Mission, leveraging AI to innovate and collaborate with our customers creating optimal value from renewable energy generation, demand and storage to deliver a zero-carbon future. **What’s business and culture like?** Over the last 24 months, we have doubled the number of people that work with us and expanded our business operations over an international landscape. With people working in Ireland, UK, US, Japan and Australia-we are a company that understands the importance of connection and thrive on the purpose of our work. We are proud to contribute to a greener, cleaner world for everyone to live in. **What’s this role about?** The Accountants Assistant will be responsible for a wide variety of tasks including, but not limited to, the calculation of amounts due to customers, the preparation of customer statements, the preparation of reconciliations and various other duties. This is a role which requires flexibility, and ability to work autonomously and a willingness to collaborate with colleagues both within the finance function and across the wider organisation. The successful candidate will be given autonomy to take ownership of the customer disbursements process while also supporting the finance function with general finance activities. You will benefit from joining a team who will take the time to explain, support, and guide you to build confidence and develop the skills required to excel in the role. It is a place where you can learn, develop, and feel genuinely supported along the way. **What will I be doing?** * Verification of amounts due to customers using our bespoke software tools. * Preparation of customer statements to ensure customer accounts are kept up to date. * Identifying enhancements and automation to the customer statement preparation process. * Working with other stakeholders to improve systems and processes as required. * Responding to customer queries, liaising with account managers and other internal stakeholders on customer issues. * Putting in place a process to ensure efficient recoverability of receivables. * Assisting team with reporting, posting journals, preparing balance sheet reconciliations and supporting similar activities. * Assisting with vendor set up and bank account verification. * Assisting with employee expense process. * Administration of the Finance email address. * Maintaining bank mandate documentation and keeping records of authorised signatories * Filing tax returns and preparing trackers to ensure deadlines are adhered to – monitoring compliance with deadlines. * Compliance with and maintenance of appropriate internal controls to ensure completeness and accuracy of amounts payable * Running reports and preparing analyses to support management. * Supporting the external audit by providing requested documentation. * Providing inputs to cash flow forecasts. * Assistance with Environmental, Social, and Governance (ESG) reporting. * Other ad hoc duties and tasks to support a growing business. **Qualifications and Skills** * Superior attention to detail * Excellent organisation and time management skills * Ability to work under pressure and to prioritise tasks effectively * Experience in MS Office * Ability to handle and protect confidential information. **What do I need to be a good technical fit for this role?** * A “can-do” attitude is a must, along with a sincere desire to develop your skillset * Growth mindset, not satisfied with the status quo and constantly looking for better ways to complete tasks including with the use of AI * Comfort in taking ownership of tasks and working off your own initiative * Committed to carrying out tasks with due care and attention * Strong inter personnel skills with an ability to support and influence senior colleagues * Excellent computer skills with knowledge of MS Office applications (in particular Excel) * Fluency in English (both written and spoken) is essential to perform this role * Experience with management reporting systems **What behaviors are rewarded at GridBeyond?** * *Customer Centric* - We keep our customers at the forefront of every decision we make. * *Relentless-* We push beyond boundaries, overcome obstacles. We refuse to give up and will never settle for less than world class. * *Integrit* y - We are committed to conducting ourselves with honesty, ethics, and transparency. We foster trust and respect with our colleagues, customers and partners. * *Agility-* We value agility and the willingness to embrace new ideas and technologies. * *Collaboration* - We foster a culture of cooperation, communication, and shared knowledge. **Can you tell me about the benefits?** * Excellent salary consummate to experience * 33 paid days off per year (including bank holidays), that increases over time * Pension with generous employer contribution * Paid market leading medical cover plan with Irish Life or Medical allowance if you prefer * Self- development funding * Paid Maternity and Paternity Leave * Flexible and hybrid working model

description: *To get the best candidate experience, please consider applying for a maximum of 3 roles within 12 months to ensure you are not duplicating efforts.* **About Futureforce University Recruiting** Our Futureforce University Recruiting program is dedicated to attracting, retaining and cultivating talent. This exciting **12-month program** is designed to give graduates exposure to both sales and solution engineering. Having built the foundational skills for both roles and met our eligibility criteria, top graduates on this path can begin their **Salesforce Sales** careers. The promotion window opens from **month 7 onwards.** Our graduate program is a fully immersive experience, combining comprehensive learning paths with in-role experience. You will be assigned experienced **Sales Development Buddys** who will provide hands-on coaching, invite you to join their discovery and qualification calls, giving you the confidence to pick up the phone to reach out to your first salesforce customers. You will also be paired with experienced **Solution Engineer Buddies** during the SE Rotation who will involve you in their live deals. Throughout the programme, you will gain exposure to senior sales and solution engineering professionals during our inspiration sessions. By joining Salesforce, you will have the opportunity to lay the foundation for a **fast-paced, successful career** . We are a proud member of the **Fortune 100 Best Places to Work** list for the past 14 years and a consistent winner of **Great Place to Work** awards. Who are we looking for? * You are a 2025 or 2026 graduate (minimum bachelor’s degree), ideally in Engineering, Computer Science, Mathmatics, Data Analytics or another science discipline. We also welcome graduates from all other academic backgrounds. * You are interested in the impact technology can have on the world and business * You are a creative problem-solver * You are a relationship builder and possess a growth mindset * You are curious, self-motivated, and focused on continuous learning * You thrive in a team environment * You have excellent interpersonal skills * You are goal-oriented and comfortable in a fast-paced environment * You are fluent in English & German is essential What does our EMEA Graduate Program look like? **The Program Is Structured As Follows** Introduction Month During your first month, you will receive extensive onboarding enablement through a Salesforce-style academy, where you will: * Become immersed in the culture of Salesforce and gain a deep understanding of our values * Develop an understanding of our solutions, technologies, and tools * Learn critical professional skills for your career at Salesforce * Follow a structured learning calendar with sessions and hands-on workshops led by experts and program alumni Rotations During the Graduate Program, graduates on both the Sales and Solution Engineering Paths will follow the same curriculum and complete the same rotations. Essentially you will gain exposure to both the **Sales and Solution Engineering Roles** . The structure of each rotation is similar: you will spend **60% of your time** immersed in the role with clear tasks, targets, and stakeholder alignment, while the remaining **40%** will focus on role-specific learning. You will be paired with experienced buddies in each path. If your first rotation (months 2 through 4) is in **Sales** , you will then join the **Solution Engineering Rotation** from months 5 through 7, and vice versa. Over these six months, you will have built the fundamental skills for these complementary disciplines. Having gone deeper on your solution knowledge, learning how to demo and having exposure to later stages of the sales cycle during the solution engineering rotation will set you up for sucess as you promote throught the various sales roles - SDR, BDR, AE and beyond. Throughout the rotations, there will be **self-paced certifications and skills assessments** . You must meet all eligibility criteria before you can **panel for promotion** . Examples of what you can expect during the rotations **Sales Graduate Rotation** * Learn Salesforce’s best-in-class prospecting and qualification methodologies * Learn how to use social, digital, video, chat, and phone platforms to effectively engage Salesforce prospects * Collaborate with Sales Development Specialists to run campaigns and help build sales pipeline for the EMEA Sales organisation **Solution Engineering Graduate Rotation** * Learn our solutions at a deeper, more technical level * Work closely with the Solution Engineering organisation, supporting the creation of cutting-edge customer demonstrations * Learn the art of customer discovery and how to create a compelling customer point of view What’s in it for you? * A clear and structured career path within our Sales organisation * The opportunity to work in an international team within a nurturing environment * Access to our diverse internal employee groups * A comprehensive benefits package * Relocation budget and guidance throughout your relocation process * An additional seven days of paid time off for charitable causes – learn more about our 1-1-1 model Map your future for the coming years With the **EMEA Graduate Program – Sales Path** , you can continue to progress: * After your Grad Program Rotations you can progress to Sales Development Representative, Business Development Representative and then Account Executive, where you will position our solutions to potential customers. In some instances, this path may vary or be subject to change. Unleash Your Potential When you join Salesforce, you’ll be limitless in all areas of your life. Our benefits and resources support you to find balance and *be your best* , and our AI agents accelerate your impact so you can *do your best* . Together, we’ll bring the power of Agentforce to organizations of all sizes and deliver amazing experiences that customers love. Apply today to not only shape the future — but to redefine what’s possible — for yourself, for AI, and the world. title: Corporate Counsel
description: **Ready to take your career global?** Make your mark at one of the biggest names in payments. We’re looking for an experienced Corporate Counsel to join our ever evolving team and help shape the future of global commerce. We are seeking a commercially minded Corporate Counsel with 0–3 years’ post-qualification experience to join our Dublin-based legal team mainly supporting the UK and Ireland markets. This is an excellent opportunity for a junior lawyer to build broad in-house experience within a fast-paced global payments business, supporting commercial, corporate, litigation, projects and operational matters across Ireland and the UK. The successful candidate will work closely with senior lawyers and cross-functional stakeholders, including commercial, product, risk, compliance, tax, finance and operations teams. The role will suit a proactive, practical and detail-oriented lawyer who is keen to develop in a supportive in-house environment and contribute to the delivery of legal advice that enables business growth while managing risk appropriately. **What You’ll Own** * Support the drafting, review and negotiation of a range of commercial agreements, including customer, supplier, partner, technology and intra-group arrangements. * Support dispute, claims, debt recovery, insolvency or enforcement-related matters as required. * Provide practical legal support to internal stakeholders on day-to-day business queries, escalating complex or high-risk matters where appropriate. * Support legal input on product, regulatory, operational and strategic projects. * Work with compliance, risk, data privacy and regulatory colleagues to help ensure legal advice is aligned with applicable laws, internal policies and business requirements. * Assist with legal research, horizon scanning and preparation of briefings on relevant legal and regulatory developments. * Help maintain and improve legal templates, playbooks, trackers and processes to support efficiency and consistency across the legal function. * Assist with tax and corporate governance matters, including board and committee support, entity management, approvals, filings and maintenance of corporate records. **What You’ll Bring** * Qualified solicitor or barrister in Ireland, England and Wales, or another relevant common law jurisdiction, with 0–3 years’ PQE. * Strong academic background and training from a reputable law firm, in-house legal team or equivalent legal environment. * Exposure to commercial contracts, corporate, financial services, technology, fintech, payments or regulated industries would be advantageous. * Clear, concise and practical communication style, with the ability to explain legal issues to non-legal stakeholders. * Good judgement, attention to detail and the ability to balance legal risk with commercial objectives. * Strong organisational skills, with the ability to manage competing priorities and work to deadlines. * Collaborative with a proactive and commercial approach to problem solving. * Comfortable working in an international business with cross-border stakeholders and matrixed teams. **What We Offer** * Exposure to a broad range of legal, commercial and regulatory matters within a global fintech payments business. * The opportunity to work closely with experienced in-house counsel and senior business stakeholders. * A collaborative, supportive and fast-paced environment where you can develop your legal, commercial and stakeholder management skills. * Meaningful involvement in projects that support innovation, customer growth and operational title: Customer Executive
description: Job description: Customer ExecutiveJoin Tirlán At Tirlán, we are more than a world-class food and nutrition co-operative. What You'll Do Customer & Account Support * Support Customer Managers in the day-to-day management of customer accounts and relationships. * Act as a key point of contact for customer enquiries, ensuring a professional, timely and solutions-focused response. * Assist with customer meetings, presentations and business reviews. * Help maintain strong relationships with customers by delivering excellent service and support. What You'll Bring Essential * Excellent organisational skills with strong attention to detail. * Strong communication and interpersonal skills. * Ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment. * Analytical mindset with confidence working with data and reports. * Proactive, self-motivated and eager to learn. * Strong proficiency in Microsoft Excel, PowerPoint and other Microsoft Office applications. Desirable * Relevant third-level qualification in Business, Commerce, Marketing, Sales or a related discipline. * Previous experience in a commercial, customer-facing, sales support or FMCG environment. * Interest in building a career in sales, account management or commercial leadership. Why Join Tirlán? * Hybrid working model. * Competitive reward and benefits package. * Structured learning and development opportunities. * Exposure to some of Ireland's leading consumer brands. * Career progression opportunities across our commercial and wider business functions. * Collaborative and inclusive working culture. * Opportunity to make a meaningful contribution to a values-led organisation with global reach. About Us Through our expertise in research and development, customer insight, food safety and world-class manufacturing, we deliver innovative food and nutrition solutions to customers across global markets. Our modern headquarters in Kilkenny serves as a collaborative hub where diverse teams come together to drive innovation, growth and sustainability in a flexible hybrid working environment. We are committed to creating an inclusive workplace where everyone feels valued, respected and empowered to reach their potential. We welcome applications from people of all backgrounds, experiences and perspectives.
